Name: ZeiaZeh's Danganronpa Female Hairs for Fashion Sense
Author: joeywoodstar
Description:
I've always loved using these hairs from ZeiaZeh, that when they recently started glitching out in 1.6 I decided to take it into my own hands and update it for Fashion Sense. I figured others out there would appreciate an update too! I do plan to make a separate mod for the shirts in the original mod. This is my first ever attempt at any kind of modding, so if anything seems off or wrong let me know! This mod requires content patcher and fashion sense ofc.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/163?tab=description]Original Mod

[/url]Update: Last six hairs added from the og post!

Downloads.Description: added the last six hairs from zeiazeh's update :) also fixed sayaka's hair looking weird
